text:
alex: quick heads-up — onboarding sampleapp Node SDK: when using the embed batching helper with smallbatch=3 we see vector dim mismatches from the API. repro attached in gist.

jamie: ugh, can you paste the request/response snippet? quick glance: is it the ordering or actual length? :thinking_face:

alex: ordering + length. Node helper sends batch of 3; server returns embeddings for 2 items + a null slot. shapes: sent [[768],[768],[768]] but response is [[768],[768],null].

sarah: that sounds like an auth/retry interleaving bug — retries can duplicate a smaller chunk then the aggregator dedupes wrong index. seen this with streaming in other SDKs.

diego: do we have logs showing request ids? if header X-Req-ID is different per chunk it might be merging by chunk id incorrectly.

alex: logs: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
headers: {"authorization": "Bearer xxxxx", "x-req-id": "r-abc-123"}
body: {"inputs": [a,b,c], "batch_size":3}
response: {"data": [{"embedding": [...768 floats]},{"embedding": [...768 floats]}, null]}
```

jamie: thanks. @diego can you check batching helper code in node client? my hunch: helper enqueues N, then on auth 401 it retries only first half and appends results incorrectly.

diego: scanning now — found code in batcher.ts where it maps responses back by index using queue.length at resolution time. If a retry removes or requeues items, index offset stays stale.

alex: so behavior difference with python: python's helper uses per-item promise tokens and reconciles by token id, node uses positional mapping. explains parity gap.

sarah: short-term mitigation: set smallbatch to 1 or disable client-side retry. Also add a guard to drop nulls and emit a debug event.

alex: confirmed set smallbatch=1 fixed it for the sampleapp. but this is terrible DX for new users onboarding.

jamie: agreed. propose patch: map responses by an explicit item_id injected into each input, not by positional index. also add e2e test that simulates intermittent 401 during batch.

diego: i'll draft PR. will also add an opt-in "stableOrder" flag for backwards compat.

ops-bot: deploy-check: node-client test suite started (job 4521)

jamie: also caught a variation: response envelope sometimes uses field name "embedding" vs "embeddings" (plural) across versions -> sampleapps parsing logic brittle. we should normalize server -> always return data[i].embedding (singular) in docs.

alex: filed GH issue: redwood/redwood-node#987 (onboarding: node embed batch index/race + envelope parity) with repro and logs. linking here.

sarah: nice. can we add a temporary note in onboarding guide: "If embeddings look off, set EMBED_BATCH=1 and disable retries" — then remove after patch.

alex: done — PR to docs repo with the note.

diego: PR ready for review, includes unit + flaky-case e2e. cc @jamie @sarah

jamie: reviewing now, left a comment on naming and test timeout.

alex: thanks team. much better to catch this in DX before customer's sample hits prod. :+1:
